reproducingTest.describe: blank lines around a healed line
tests: reports the line of the call, not a blank line above it
keeps the blank lines that follow a healed wait
does not insert a blank line after a healed wait with none below it
counts a later rule's line against the original file, not the rewritten one
leaves a multi-line wait call alone rather than collapsing its lines
keeps CRLF line endings and still heals the line
reproducingTest.origin: bug-fleet repro commit 84e1580eeeb12d7977368ef75e73994de4848fa5 (first two tests), extended here

assumptions: Root cause is `\s` used where the rules mean horizontal whitespace on one line; the fix uses `[ \t]` and keeps every rule a line-for-line substitution, so line counts are invariant across passes and lineOf on rewritten text equals the original line (this is how the stale-line-count defect is fixed, rather than a separate offset map).

HEAL-001/002 sleep/wait arguments no longer cross a newline (`[^)\n]*`): a multi-line time.sleep(...) or page.waitForTimeout(...) is now left untouched instead of being collapsed to one line. HEAL-003 keeps its multi-line argument match because it only inserts `await` and never changes the line count.
The line end accepts an optional `\r` so CRLF files still heal and keep their `\r`; previously `\s*` silently stripped it.

Re-baselining the frozen Python-parity golden ts/test/fixtures/core-golden/pattern-healer.json (time_sleep, wait_for_timeout, multi_fix) is accepted: the human-confirmed decision to fix all three defects requires it, and only the blank-line, leading-newline and line-number fields change.
`HealChange.before` is now exactly the matched line text (it never contains a newline), so the rstripNewlines helper was removed.
